Bollywood Dandiya 2026 – Cedar Park, TX

Get ready for an unforgettable evening of Bollywood music, Garba, Dandiya, dance, and nonstop festive energy at Bollywood Dandiya 2026!

For the second year in a row, G2 Entertainment is bringing Austin’s electrifying Bollywood Dandiya celebration to Cedar Park — and this year, it’s a two-night celebration! Enjoy traditional Garba, Bollywood beats, music, dance, and festive vibes. Gather your family and friends and celebrate Navratri with an unforgettable evening of culture, tradition, and fun!

Event Details:

Date: Saturday, October 17, 2026

Time: 7:00 PM

Doors Open: 6:00 PM

Venue: Austin Sports Center - Cedar Park

Address: 1420 Toro Grande Boulevard, Cedar Park, TX 78613

Don’t miss this exciting Bollywood Dandiya celebration in Cedar Park! Kids under 10 are free.
